CLOUD PROBE seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic mrbatch, at head f2fb1b0e950ecd047b7f08b3adef93776a622540. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: a read-only probe. Measure what the brief below asks against the tree at f2fb1b0e950ecd047b7f08b3adef93776a622540 (`git fetch origin f2fb1b0e950ecd047b7f08b3adef93776a622540`); change no tracked file; the only refs you push are the probe refs the brief names.
Output: write your result as a body file and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh mrbatch <result.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/mrbatch; that push is the return signal. A return push carries only your own result tokens.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
MARKERS-ONLY RE-READS for four PRs of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, one verdict each. Authority: owner pack revision 15 step 0c. For each PR below: the head is unchanged only if `gh pr view N --json headRefOid` (one call per PR) equals the listed head; if it moved, skip that PR and say so. Each PR already holds a 'Fix review: merge <head>' (or for #2571 a merge) verdict in its comments at that exact head (read the last such comment with gh api repos/tvofi/heatpump_optimizer/issues/N/comments); that verdict stands. The merge train's pre-flight parks the PR because some notes in it are read as findings without a Carry marker. Read tools/audit/carry_audit.py (module docstring: the grammar), git fetch origin handoff/audit-r10-roster, run python3 tools/audit/carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster over the earlier verdict text (check subcommand; read its usage) and list the unrouted item ids. Write verdict_N.md: first line exactly 'Fix review: merge <head>', a blank line, 'bus-nonce: <nonce>', a short statement that it is a markers-only re-issue routing the items (re-check only: head unchanged, git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head> clean, required check-runs not red; pending: say which), then one marker per unrouted item id: 'Carry: dismissed <reason of two or more words> (item <id>)' where the observation is deliberately left as is, or 'Carry: <GROUP-ID> (item <id>)' only for a group on origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster. Do not invent groups, do not re-review the code. Run carry_audit over your own verdict text and require 0 unrouted. Put evidence in ev_N/ with ev_N/HEAD.txt holding the full head. Return each verdict on its own probe ref, building one parentless commit per PR with a private index: W=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $W/pr; cp verdict_N.md $W/pr/verdict.md; cp -r ev_N $W/pr/ev; then R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); T=$(cd $W/pr && GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree'); C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict N <head>"); git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-N-<first 8 hex of the nonce>. Do not run bus.sh, post comments, approve or merge.
